idea: Same two-person comic argument, but 3-second shots, a real Chrome Help proof card, event-tied sound, and a last line that loops to the hook.

improve.rule: Show real evidence the reference does not: real captures (page, repo, post, terminal) on screen.
Sound tied to visual events at a density near the reference, with no sound that has no cause.
The last line echoes a content word of the first line, so the replay feels seamless.
Same family of pace, never slower: median shot no longer than the reference, cuts per 10 s at least 90 percent of it.
At least three different emotions across the spoken lines (story and dialogue films).
